name: Review Agent Tool Boundaries
summary: Review agent and MCP tool authority against prompt injection, confused-deputy, exfiltration, and unsafe side effects.
description: Review an agent, MCP server, plugin, or tool workflow for prompt-injection paths, identity propagation, least privilege, data exposure, confirmation, and failure safety. Use before granting an agent access to real systems or expanding tool permissions.
risk_reason: This skill reviews agent and MCP tool authority against prompt injection, confused-deputy, exfiltration, and unsafe side effects; it does not rely on prompt wording alone to protect secrets, writes, tenants, or external systems.
refuses: It does not rely on prompt wording alone to protect secrets, writes, tenants, or external systems.
It does not request broad credentials, disable confirmation, or test attacks against unauthorized targets.
It does not describe a tool surface as secure when critical authority paths or negative tests remain unresolved.
